measurement: Windows actual-worker input; 1 warmup and 2 measured samples per case and revision; milliseconds.

interpretation.published: First operation invocation to first publication; for bursts this is not the final publication.
interpretation.finalPublished: First operation invocation to last publication in the burst.
interpretation.complete: First operation invocation to completion of the entire operation or burst.
interpretation.grammarSettled: First operation invocation to final authoritative parent syntax settlement.
interpretation.invocationToObservedFrame: First invocation to observed composited frame containing final visible DOM acknowledgement; includes capture overhead, not physical display presentation.
interpretation.queue: Wait, latency and arrival-delay samples cover individual operations in both measured trials.
interpretation.recycleRequests: Latched requests repeated on private-session release; counts are not restart or memory-pressure-failure counts.

limits: No timing thresholds, parser/query/resource-policy patches or scheduling overrides.
Two measured samples do not establish tail latency percentiles.
Every cycle verified exact source, cursor positions, publication snapshots and undo/redo outside timings.
Burst schedules target 16ms arrivals without awaiting command completion or syntax settlement.
Frame cases use normal visible applications; other cases use the standard isolated Jasmine renderer.
Continuous input still builds queues; cold initial input, files over 500KiB and long-session memory plateau were not validated.
